SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No.
S. B. REGISTRY
Section D. 2 Station
Date 25 / 4 / 32
1932

Subject (in full) Arrest of Communist Suspect by Yulin Road Station on
August 22, 1932.

Made by D.S.I. Everast. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the attached memo from the Officer i/c
Special Branch regarding a report made by D. S. Hide of Yulin
Road Station on the subject of the arrest and subsequent release
of a person found in possession of communist literature on
August 22, I have to report having brought the contents of the
aforementioned memo to the notice of D. S. Hide.

Regarding this matter D. S. Hide stated that although
he had omitted to mention the fact in his report, the points
raised by the Officer i/c Special Branch in the aforementioned
memo had been fully covered, but without result.

Summarized translations of the handbills are attached
herewith.

[Signature]
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（印：八角形印章，内含文字及图案）

上海公共租界工部局警务处

S. B. 登记处
D区第2巡捕房
日期 1932年4月25日
1932年

主题（全称）：1932年8月22日榆林路巡捕房逮捕共产党嫌疑犯一事。

由副督察长 Everast 撰写。经由 [签名] 转呈

兹参照特务科主管警官所附备忘录，该备忘录涉及榆林路巡捕房副督察长 Hide 就1932年8月22日逮捕一名持有共产主义宣传品者随后将其释放一事所作的报告。本人须报告，已将上述备忘录的内容告知副督察长 Hide。

关于此事，副督察长 Hide 称，虽然他在报告中未提及这一事实，但特务科主管警官在上述备忘录中提出的要点已得到充分涵盖，但未获结果。

随函附上传单摘要译文。

[签名]
副督察长

特务科主管警官。

（印：八角形印章，内含文字及图案）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

Political File No. 63
Route Station,
3962
23 32
Date 23, August, 1932.

REPORT

Subject (in full) Possession of Communistic Pamphlets.

Made by D. S. Hide Forwarded by Insp. i/c Holl.

Sir;

At 5.50 p.m. on the 22-8-32 P.S. 55 brought to the station
a Chinese Tsou Ming Ching (周明慶), aged 18, native of Ningpo, who
was arrested on Nanking Road while hawking a basket of cakes which
were contained a small quantity of Communistic pamphlets which were
being used for the purpose of wrapping up the cakes.

On interrogation Tsou Ming Ching stated the pamphlets were
given him by Wong Sau Kung the owner of a cake shop on
Nanking Road, who had obtained them two days previously from a
Chinese boy in exchange for seven two coiner cakes.

The undersigned and I.P. 218 visited the shop but the owner
Wong Sau Kung (王秀康) was out, however, on questioning his wife
she gave the same account as to the manner in which they came to be
in possession of the pamphlets. She was instructed to tell Wong to
attend the station on his return.

At 7 p.m. Wong Sau Kung came to the station and was thoroughly
interrogated, he also gave the same story and no further informa-
tion was obtained. He stated that neither he, his wife or the boy
are able to read, and were consequently unaware of the nature of
the pamphlets.

Under the foregoing circumstances, it was not considered
necessary to communicate with the Special Branch and those concerned
were cautioned and released.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
Lawrence Hide

O. C. Special Branch. D. S.
D.D.O. "D" (signature)

日期 1932年8月23日。

报告

主题（全称）：持有共产主义小册子。

由副督察长 Hide 撰写，由主管督察长 Holl 转呈。

先生；

1932年8月22日下午5时50分，第55号华籍巡捕将一名华人周明慶带至巡捕房，该人18岁，宁波籍，在南京路兜售一篮蛋糕时被捕，蛋糕中夹带少量共产主义小册子，用于包裹蛋糕。

经讯问，周明慶称这些小册子是南京路一家蛋糕店店主王秀康给他的，王秀康两天前从一名中国男孩处获得这些小册子，交换条件是七个两枚铜板价的蛋糕。

本人与第218号印度巡捕前往该店，但店主王秀康外出，不过经询问其妻子，她对于如何获得这些小册子的说法与上述一致。已指示她告知王秀康回来后到巡捕房报到。

晚上7时，王秀康来到巡捕房并接受彻底讯问，他也讲述了同样的故事，未获得进一步信息。他声称他、他的妻子及那个男孩均不识字，因此不知道小册子的性质。

鉴于上述情况，认为无需与特务科联系，相关人员受到警告后予以释放。

此致，
敬礼，
Lawrence Hide

特务科主管警官。副督察长
“D”区副总监（签名）
发送：侦探主管

Political File No. 63
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Yulin Road Station,
REPORT
Date 23, August, 19 32.

Subject (in full) Possession of Communistic Pamphlets.

Made by D. S. Hide Forwarded by Insp. 1/o Hall.

Sir;
At 5.50.p.m. on the 22-8-32 J.P.S. 55 brought to the station
a Chinese Tseu Ming Ching (周明慶), aged 18, native of Kompo, who
he arrested on Tsitsuihar Road while hawking a basket of cakes which
also contained a small quantity of Communistic pamphlets which were
being used for the purpose of wrapping up the cakes.
On interrogation Tseu Ming Ching stated the pamphlets were
given him by his employer the owner of a straw nut cake shop on
Yenshan Road, who had obtained them two days previously from a
Chinese boy in exchange for seven two copper cakes.
The undersigned and C.D.C. 218 visited the shop but the owner
Wong Shu Kung (王少康) was out, however, on questioning his wife
she gave the same account as to the manner in which they came to be
in possession of the pamphlets. She was instructed to tell Wong to
attend the station on his return.
At 7.p.m. Wong Shu Kung came to the station and was thoroughly
interrogated, he also gave the same story and no further informa-
tion was obtained. He stated that neither he, his wife or the boy
are able to read, and were consequently unaware of the nature of
the pamphlets.
Under the foregoing circumstances, it was not considered
necessary to communicate with the Special Branch and those concerned
were cautioned and released.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
(S/B) Lawrence Hide
D. S.

O. C. Special Branch,
D.D.O. "B"
Sent Dat: 1/8

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER ; AUG 25 1932 ; CRIME BRANCH）

报告
日期 1932年8月23日。

主题（全称）：持有共产主义小册子。

由副督察长 Hide 撰写，由主管督察长 Hall 转呈。

先生；
1932年8月22日下午5时50分，第55号华籍巡捕将一名华人周明慶带至巡捕房，该人18岁，Kompo（原文不清，疑为宁波或某地误拼）籍，他在齐齐哈尔路（Tsitsuihar Road）兜售一篮蛋糕时被捕，蛋糕中也夹带少量共产主义小册子，用于包裹蛋糕。
经讯问，周明慶称这些小册子是他的雇主、燕山路上的一家草果饼店店主给他的，店主两天前从一名中国男孩处获得这些小册子，交换条件是七个两枚铜板价的蛋糕。
本人与第218号华籍侦探前往该店，但店主王少康（Wong Shu Kung）外出，不过经询问其妻子，她对于如何获得这些小册子的说法与上述一致。已指示她告知王少康回来后到巡捕房报到。
晚上7时，王少康来到巡捕房并接受彻底讯问，他也讲述了同样的故事，未获得进一步信息。他声称他、他的妻子及那个男孩均不识字，因此不知道小册子的性质。
鉴于上述情况，认为无需与特务科联系，相关人员受到警告后予以释放。

此致，
敬礼，
(S/B) Lawrence Hide
副督察长

特务科主管警官，
“B”区副总监
发送日期：1/8

（印：副总监；1932年8月25日；罪案科）
